notes.title: Update 0.6: Trains!
notes.notes:
Hi Crafters!

Today's update introduces Trains!

Freight trains are an efficient way to transport large quantities of materials over a long distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890006/7eaf92ff1b56e00486c0c622d14a8efaabeffb9a.jpg

Train Station can take material from a selected Freight Car, and put material in another one. You can add as many freight cars as you need on a train, and set each Train Station to work with different freight cars. This way, transporting different materials across a long distance in the same train is very easy.

You can either use single-side railways and use Buffer stop to make the train reverse direction when reaching the end, or use double-sided railways sections if you want multiple trains to work on the same track without issue.

For very long distance, use Rail Supports that will let you easily create railways across the planet: for example, you can place a Rail Support on an island, place a second Rail Support on a different island and activate it to automatically lay down a railway connecting the two Rail Supports.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890006/cee0260f208e940a9bac9ad692729b436c00337f.jpg

Update 0.60b:
- Trains
- Warehouse T3 now has outputs in addition to the inputs
- Fixed misc. bugs

Thank you for your support and don't forget to join our Discord or post in the Steam community forums!

notes.title: Update 0.49b: Controller Support and Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Hi Crafters!

Controller support was in beta mode for a few weeks, it's now officially supported, but we still want to hear your feedback if you think some mapping should be changed.

The game is now optimized for Steam Deck. When you launch the game on Steam Deck, make sure you select the Gamepad With Camera controls template.

This update also brings some new terraformation objectives: when you are in the current last stage, you'll now see the percent done of various tasks, and a global Planetary Habitability Index which lets you know how much of the planet is now considered ready to be a new home for humanity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890006/958a0f010d1dfa957eb43be519972293810d5c10.jpg

Update 0.49b:
- New terraformation information in Planet Analyser and Monitoring Screen
- Improved controller support: in Build menu, hold A to choose the slot in your hotbar. In inventory/build menu, X is now equivalent to Shift+Left Click (build items part 10 by 10, transfer whole stacks,...) and Y equivalent to Ctrl+Left Click.
- Steam Deck optimizations
- Fixed misc. bugs

We would like to give you some information about the upcoming release of the third planet, Aetheria. Because of the recent updates in other parts of the game, there's still some work in progress in the new planet, and it will be delayed for a few days: it will be available before mid-December. Sorry for this slight delay, but we prefer to polish the new planet rather than rush its release!

Thank you for your support and don't forget to join our Discord or post in the Steam community forums!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi Crafters!

We're thrilled to finally announce the Early Access release date for Eden Crafters! Mark your calendars for October 16th, when the game will be available for around $19 USD, with regional pricing in other countries.

This Early Access version introduces some new planets for you to explore, terraform, and automate. We've added a ton of exciting new features compared to the Ocean World prologue:

 3 planets to explore and terraform (including one releasing early November, with more to come during Early Access as free updates)
 28 production and logistics machines, with 3 tiers of conveyors for advanced factory building
 17 different resources and 58 crafting parts to discover and create
 12 terraformation buildings to help you tackle the challenges of these new worlds
 A lot of new base building elements
 2 spaceships and 3 land vehicles, a tool to build roads
 And much more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890006/7b77d64ef4096426ceba471f09f537d4c59337bc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890006/1e0baf34102731660f8df7fa173960ce29a206c0.jpg

We can’t wait to hear your feedback during the Early Access phase as we continue to shape and improve Eden Crafters together. Your input has always been invaluable for our development process!

Thank you for your continued support, and don’t forget to join the conversation on our Discord or Steam community forums!
